task.description:
Run the E2E test suite for the React Flow canvas features. Benchmark environment has been verified (bench PASS). Steps:
1. Ensure backend is running on port 8080 (start-backend.ps1 if not)
2. cd web && npx playwright test f2-canvas.e2e.spec.ts --reporter=list
3. Capture all output: passed, failed, skipped counts
4. If any test fails, write a detailed failure report to tests/reports/
5. Take screenshots of failures for diagnosis
acceptance_criteria: All E2E tests for canvas features pass or failures are documented with root cause

result.summary: All 13 E2E tests failed at setup: POST /api/v1/definitions returns 400 (malformed_json). Root cause: test graph data uses field name "name" but backend GraphNode expects "label". Secondary: attributes field sent as JSON object but backend expects JSON string.

issues.description: All 13 tests fail due to field name mismatch: test sends "name" but backend expects "label" in GraphNode. Fix by replacing "name" with "label" in graph template functions (startEndGraph, threeNodeGraph, gatewayGraph, and inline graph definitions in f2-canvas.e2e.spec.ts).
Secondary: attributes field sent as JSON object but backend expects ?[]const u8 (JSON string). E.g., attributes: { assignee_type: "user" } should be attributes: "{\"assignee_type\":\"user\"}"

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV or FRONTEND-DEV to fix test data format: change "name" to "label" in all GraphNode entries, and serialize attributes as JSON strings.
